headline: Loan authorization for police station's fire wing, Sweetgreen permit at 96 Tower Road, and CVS and fortune teller license renewals top the agenda.
summary: Committees will consider a $462,755.00 loan authorization for additional design services for the Fire Administration Wing of the Police Station, a special permit for Sweetgreen Boston LLC at 96 Tower Road (1265 Main Development), and license renewals for CVS Pharmacy #114 at 12 Harvard Street and a fortune teller business at 24 Crescent St Suite 401F. The Committee of the Whole will hear a presentation on the Police/Fire/911 building complex by Tecton Architects and vote on two Council on Aging Board appointments, while the Finance Committee will review a $120,000.00 cemetery truck appropriation and two grant acceptances.

NGrid petition 17-25 at 205 Second Ave

Appropriation of $120,000 from Cemetery Sale of Lots & Graves for a truck for the PW Cemetery Division
Acceptance of the FFY2027 Municipal Road Safety Grant of $52,152 for the Police Department
Acceptance of a $9,000 Department of Energy grant for new EV chargers in the City's public parking lots project
Special permit application for Sweetgreen Boston LLC at 96 Tower Road (1265 Main Development)
Compensation Ordinance Amendment for election personnel
Mayor's request for advisement on easement and parking space at 210-220 Moody Street

Tabled special permit applications: 20 Williams Street for Sam-EJ Realty Trust, 287 Crescent Street for Dyer's Crescent Suites LLC, 995 Main Street for Service Credit Union, and MICOL, LLC at 220 Moody Street
